First, we isolate the square root:

$$
\begin{aligned}2\sqrt{3x+6}+11 & \ge 5 \\ 2\sqrt{3x+6} & \ge -6 \\ \sqrt{3x+6} & \ge -3\end{aligned}
$$

Here, the square root is greater than a negative number $(-3),$ so any number we can substitute into the square root will satisfy the inequality. So, the solution is the domain of the square root.

To find the domain, we recall that the expression under the square root must be greater than or equal to $0:$

$$
3x+6\ge 0\,⇒\,x\ge -2
$$

Therefore, the solution is $x\ge -2.$
